proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Run-style redesign intentionally resolves executable/path commands rather than evaluating arbitrary input in a configured shell; profile-only functions are outside that contract.

confidence.rationale: The missing contract and maintainer intent are explicit; the selected UI/shell/profile integration and runtime test matrix remain to be designed.

plan: Define an explicit shell action/mode and supported shell/profile-loading behavior with the maintainer; retain current normal executable resolution.
